inclusions.source: The yacht is private to your party — never shared with other guests — and the outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group.
An in-water instructor, all snorkelling equipment, and one bottle of mineral water per person (alongside other refreshments) are included.

inclusions.source: An in-water instructor, all snorkelling equipment, and one bottle of mineral water per person (alongside other refreshments) are included.
Pickup is from your Marsa Alam hotel in the morning, after which you transfer to the port and board the yacht.
After the first dive, you return to the yacht for a buffet lunch served on board — the specifics vary by season and provisioning, but the format is a proper sit-down meal, not a packed sandwich.
The return transfer to your hotel completes the day.
